# Notices and license elections

This maintained fork is MIT licensed. Retain the upstream Hufe copyright and
license in LICENSE with every redistribution. New headless exchange code is
also distributed under MIT. No proprietary or AGPL application/engine code is
included.

The original upstream source-lock runtime closure has 26 entries, including two
type packages. Their immutable package-integrity/version/license inventory and
retained legal files are in provenance/upstream-dependency-inventory.json and
provenance/notices/. They are provenance evidence; the old browser bundle and
its runtime dependencies are excluded from this headless release.

JSZip 3.10.1 is dual licensed. **Proser explicitly elects JSZip's MIT option.**
The complete upstream license notice is retained. Pako's MIT and Zlib notices
are retained, including the embedded Zlib source copyright/license comments.
BlueOak, ISC and MIT notices of all other original closure entries remain intact.

The actual runtime closure is pinned independently in package-lock.json:
@xmldom/xmldom, buffer-crc32, pend, saxes, xmlchars, yauzl, yazl and zod.
Their notices and exact rebuilt release SBOM are generated by the owned release
manifest tool; do not infer bundled dependencies from a package-manager audit
alone. Node/type packages are development-only; the TypeScript compiler is
recorded separately because compiled CommonJS helpers can be emitted into the
release. Its license and third-party notices remain in runtime-notices/.

This distribution contains no bundled font or image files. Applications supply
fonts/assets with their own upstream licenses and immutable digests.
